reason: I'd try the 40 free documents out of curiosity, but I wouldn't pay. My build only throws off a few dozen transfers and receipts a month, and I can wire up n8n with ChatGPT to dump them into a Google Sheet over a weekend.
objection: This is a wrapper around OCR plus a spreadsheet. I'd be giving a bot I've never heard of every invoice and bank screenshot from my project, and paying $19 a month for something I could build myself.
would_change_my_mind: If the free trial actually caught a duplicate or padded invoice from my contractor that I'd missed, it would pay for itself and I'd stop arguing with myself about building my own.
